title: A Vow for the Bakery
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Edmund Galloway, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
